data.name: Command Undead (Mythic)
data.description: Your control of the undead is nearly absolute. When you command undead, the DC of the Will save increases by , and intelligent undead get no additional saves beyond their first to resist your commands. Any attempts by non-mythic creatures to control undead you command automatically fail, and you gain a +4 bonus on Charisma checks to prevent mythic creatures from stealing control of your undead.
